description: DENSE-v1: LEAN-v17 + dense closed-form block appended at end. Total dense add: 736 raw dim, ~2944 post-delay. All filters NAMED (rate Hz, scale cyc/chan, dir). Baseline LEAN-v17 was 0.0778; Whisper bar is 0.0821. Targeting the missing Whisper-side signal with finer ERB + denser rate×scale modulation tuning. SCORE: TBD. STUB: cond_mode=none

subject: patient1
description: DENSE-v3: LEAN-v17 + per-band TEMPORAL MODULATION FILTERBANK (modulation spectrogram). 64-ch ERB cochleagram pooled to 32 bands; for each band, apply 8 Gabor temporal filters at log-spaced rates (1, 2, 3, 4.5, 6, 9, 14, 22 Hz) using cos/sin quadrature pair → energy magnitude. 32 × 8 = 256 raw dim, 1024 post-delay. Each filter NAMED (band k, rate Hz). DENSE-v1 (0.0768) and DENSE-v2 (0.0771) added cochleagram/STMF redundant with LEAN; DENSE-v3 swaps to PER-BAND temporal rate code — captures slow-fast modulation tuning per frequency, the canonical Greenberg/Schreiner modulation spectrogram. Baseline LEAN-v17 = 0.0778; Whisper = 0.0821. SCORE: TBD. STUB: cond_mode=none

description: DENSE-v4: LEAN-v17 + dense STMF SUPPLEMENT with rate/scale values NOT in LEAN's 17-filter STMF grid. Applied to 20-channel LEAN long-window log-coch (full per-band output, no pooling — preserves finest spectral precision). NEW rates {1, 1.5, 3, 5, 6, 10, 16, 22} Hz × NEW scales {0.125, 0.75, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0} cyc/chan × 2 sweep dirs = 96 Gabor filters, energy from quadrature pair, output (T, 20) per filter → 1920 raw dim, 7680 post-delay. Total feat ~14k.
